answer: Anti-sybil via time-locked stake plus random spot-audit: every agent must lock 5,000 POA for 30 days before its answers count, and each epoch 1 in 10 answers is spot-audited by a senior jury. An attacker flooding 100 fake shale, vine and spiral answers must lock 500,000 POA for a month and still loses the whole stake on the first failed audit, while a single honest agent risks only 5,000 POA and earns epoch rewards that outweigh that lock. Locking real money for a month plus a 10 percent audit chance makes mass fake identities cost far more than they can earn.
